selection_reason: Pinned repository runtime JSON resolves to 3 epochs; paper/code discrepancy is retained.
Official warmup reference is 100 optimizer steps.
32 records times 3 epochs gives only 96 exposures and at most 96 step boundaries at microbatch 1 / accumulation 1.
Larger batches or accumulation reduce optimizer updates further.
Three epochs can remain entirely within warmup, inconsistent with the selected formal training setting.
Thirty epochs gives 960 exposures and meaningful post-warmup optimization with this one-record update budget.
tail_accumulation_semantics: Accumulation=1; every one of 32 records produces one optimizer call each epoch, 32*30=960; no partial accumulation, dropping, padding or cross-epoch carry.
optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW, GPU resident FP32 master parameters and moments
scheduler: Pinned DeepSpeed WarmupLR log schedule, min=0 max=2e-5, held constant after warmup; LR sequence verified against installed official class
precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 GPU master parameters, gradients and optimizer states; final model saved BF16
objective: Causal SFT cross entropy; prompt labels=-100; official assistant tokens and terminator retained
checkpoint_policy: final weights only, separate preflight output, no intermediate checkpoint deletion
preflight: Same primary protocol, stop after update 3 (first nonzero LR); require finite loss/gradients and changed trainable parameter witnesses; weights not reused by formal run
